name: Title bar
description: Draws the bar at the top of each window: the commands, the vault and the window buttons

settings.title: Window buttons
settings.description: Where the bar draws the minimize, maximize and close buttons: at the right like Windows, at the left like macOS, or not at all. macOS always keeps the system buttons at the left. On Windows, the buttons at the left lose the Snap Layouts menu.

options.title: Left
options.detail: Round buttons at the left, as on macOS.

options.title: Right
options.detail: Square buttons at the right, as on Windows.

options.title: None
options.detail: The bar draws no window buttons.

settings.title: Hide in full screen
settings.description: Draw no bar while the window is in full screen, so the tabs start at the top of the window. The bar is drawn again when the window leaves full screen.
